notes.title: Bug acknowledgement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we just wanted to let you know we're aware of the bug regarding the bat not moving all the way to the left/right of the screen. 

From some initial tests it seems you should be able to play the game normally if you have your sensitivity slider over 17%, this hopefully works for you while we try to sort out the problem. 

We'll look into a proper fix ASAP. 

Thank you for your patience

notes.title: Latest update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we've been busy with other projects lately but have found some downtime to tweak Ionball 2. 

The patch has fixed it so Xbox controller now works properly in the levels, sadly we can't make it work in the menus just yet. 

We have also (finally) added an input sensitivity controller to edit mouse speed. 

Some people don't seem to be getting the sensitivity controller, if this is the case we ask you to reinstall the game if you want to use it (we're working on why it's not showing up). 

Thank you again for all of your support :)

notes.title: Tower Assault DLC available now!
notes.notes:
The Tower Assault DLC delivers an all new survival style game mode to Ionball 2: Ionstorm, with 30 new levels where you must last as long as you can to get the best score on the Ionball 2: Ionstorm leaderboard.  Once all 30 levels are completed you can re-start the game at which point the difficulty moves up a notch.

Other features included with this DLC:
An all new top-down classic game view.
Ability to turn off explosions for better visibility.
Option to use an XBox control pad.
The re-spawn time of the bat after death has been halved.
All new music tracks
A new ‘wave’ system where each 'level' has 3 waves for faster paced action and less down-time.
Available to download free or included in new purchases

notes.title: Announcing Tower Assault DLC!!
notes.notes:
Ironsun Studios are proud to announce the release of a major new update for Ionball 2: Ionstorm. Read all the new goodies below;

New game mode:  Tower Assault - prepare for frenzied action with 30 new levels, updated graphics and a new selection of new music tracks.

New wave system for less breaks in the action and dropdown upgrades for mass destruction!

New options:  Minimise FX - removes droid explosions so as not to obscure the ball.
  Control options - allows use of xbox 360 controller.
  Choose between standard game tracks or new Tower Assault tracks.
  New top-down view option.
  
Bug Fixes/Enhancements: * Mouse control getting stuck fixed.
   * Fast respawn after bat destruction

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
* Some graphical and performance improvements

* Bug fixes:
 - All active balls will stop immediately when final droid is destroyed rather than waiting for it to finish exploding
 - Player will get opposite powerup on collecting a power capsule with an existing power still in-play
 - Mouse will not affect bat position when outside the play area 
 - Level numbers (per floor) now shown in tower

* Optional weapon hints for in-game hud

notes.title: Ionball 2: Ionstorm is unleashed!
notes.notes:
We at [b]Ironsun Studios[/b] are proud to announce the release of our latest and greatest title, [b]Ionball 2: Ionstorm.[/b] It’s taken us blood, sweat and much whisky to create the game that we now can unleash on the general public

Countless waking hours of testing un-ending onslaughts of droids, only to be woken by the withering eyes of Leviathan itself have finally allowed us to complete the game ready for your general scrutiny, we really hope you enjoy it. 

To see what surprises we have planned to celebrate the release of the game, please go to our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/IronsunStudios. [b]Welcome to Ionstorm![/b]
